name: Playwright-backed Control Room frontend verification
acceptanceCriteria: The founder can invoke one allowlisted verify-frontend mission that runs the repository Playwright smoke suite when Chromium is available.
The generated report states browserProof=true only after a successful Playwright run and never treats local fallback verification as browser evidence.
Missing Playwright or Chromium produces an explicit non-browser fallback report instead of a silent skip or false green browser claim.
Pull-request CI, unit tests, and Playwright checks pass on the current main lineage before promotion beyond integrated.

verification.blocker: The current-head pull request must pass unit, type, quality, regression, and Playwright checks; a retained real browser report is still required before verified status.

rollback: Remove the verify-frontend mission, Playwright connector registration, runner script, tests, and this extension. Existing Playwright CI and verify:local remain available.
